evidence: Ta-N ﬁlms were deposited on SiO2 ~100 nm in thickness!/Si wafers at a deposition temperature of 260°C and a deposition pressure of 1 Torr. TBTDET was contained in a bubbler which was heated at 70°C and carried by an argon ﬂow rate of 35 cm3/min. One deposition cycle consists of an exposure to a metallorganic precursor of TBTDET, a purge period with an argon ﬂow rate of 35 cm3/min, and an exposure to hydrogen plasma, followed by another purge period with an argon ﬂow rate of 35 cm3/min. The Ar purge period of 15 s was inserted between each reactant gas pulse in order to isolate the reactant gases from each other.
